heading: Explicit Control Boundaries
content: Define who can invoke an AI workflow, which tools it can reach, and what actions require review before rollout.

heading: Privacy-Aware Inference
content: Use Hyper-ABS concepts to reduce unnecessary raw-data exposure before model calls. It helps lower exposure but does not guarantee privacy by itself.

heading: Verifiable Execution Records
content: Use Hyper-0x to retain attributable records of configured AI actions so teams can review what was requested, allowed, and executed.

heading: Custom AI Support
content: Plan custom model and fine-tuning work around data boundaries, evaluation expectations, and practical deployment controls.
